source_row.rationale: Effective sterilization depends on adequate cleaning. CDC guidance states that devices should be cleaned as soon as practical after use because dried soil makes removal more difficult and can interfere with disinfection or sterilization. Point-of-use handling should follow validated manufacturer instructions rather than improvised chemicals.
source_row.source_detail: Cleaning section: clean medical devices as soon as practical after use because materials become dried onto instruments; cleaning is required before high-level disinfection and sterilization.
source_row.source_name: CDC — Guideline for Disinfection and Sterilization in Healthcare Facilities
source_row.stem: A reusable surgical instrument is heavily soiled with blood and tissue during a procedure. Which point-of-use practice best supports effective later reprocessing?
